Description: Unique synthetic identifier assigned to each fertility clinic patient (Primary Key).
Analytical_Purpose: Entity identification and relational join key to ivf_treatment_cycles.csv

Description: Maternal age in completed years at baseline clinic registration.
Analytical_Purpose: Evaluate age-stratified ovarian reserve, embryo development, and pregnancy/live birth outcomes

Description: Patient Body Mass Index calculated as weight (kg) divided by height squared (m^2).
Analytical_Purpose: Assess metabolic profile associations with stimulation response and implantation success

Description: Duration in years the patient/couple attempted conception prior to IVF intake.
Analytical_Purpose: Examine relationship between duration of subfertility and cycle outcomes

Description: Classification of prior conception history (Primary: never conceived; Secondary: prior conception).
Analytical_Purpose: Compare baseline demographics and IVF success rates between primary and secondary infertility

Description: Number of unsuccessful or prior IVF cycles completed before the current clinic series.
Analytical_Purpose: Analyze prognosis across first-time versus repeat IVF patients

Description: Serum Anti-Mullerian Hormone concentration in ng/mL measuring functional ovarian reserve.
Analytical_Purpose: Predict oocyte yield, protocol selection, and risk of low or hyper-response

Description: Basal Day-3 serum Follicle-Stimulating Hormone concentration in mIU/mL.
Analytical_Purpose: Complementary endocrine indicator of ovarian reserve and gonadotropin sensitivity

Description: Primary clinical etiology of infertility recorded at baseline evaluation.
Expected_Values: Male Factor, Ovulatory Dysfunction / PCOS, Tubal Factor, Unexplained Infertility, Endometriosis, Diminished Ovarian Reserve, Uterine Factor
Analytical_Purpose: Stratify treatment modality selection, oocyte yield, costs, and live birth proportions

Description: Unique synthetic identifier for each initiated IVF treatment cycle (Primary Key).
Analytical_Purpose: Primary analytical unit linking patients, embryo cohorts, outcomes, and cycle costs

Description: Foreign key referencing the patient undergoing the IVF cycle in patients.csv.
Analytical_Purpose: Link patient-level baseline demographics and biomarkers to cycle-level performance

Description: Calendar date of IVF cycle initiation.
Analytical_Purpose: Temporal trend tracking, quarterly volume monitoring, and operational capacity planning

Description: Core assisted reproductive technology modality employed for the cycle.
Expected_Values: Conventional IVF, ICSI, IVF + PGT-A, Mild Stimulation IVF
Analytical_Purpose: Compare clinical effectiveness and cost-efficiency across treatment modalities

Description: Controlled ovarian hyperstimulation (COH) regimen administered prior to retrieval.
Expected_Values: GnRH Antagonist, GnRH Agonist Long, Mild / Minimal Stimulation, Flare-Up Protocol
Analytical_Purpose: Evaluate protocol associations with oocyte yield, medication expenditure, and outcomes

Description: Total number of cumulus-oocyte complexes aspirated at transvaginal retrieval.
Analytical_Purpose: Primary ovarian response metric and denominator for oocyte maturation rate

Description: Count of Metaphase II (MII) mature oocytes eligible for insemination (<= Retrieved_Oocytes).
Analytical_Purpose: Assess nuclear oocyte maturity and laboratory readiness for fertilization

Description: Count of two-pronuclear (2PN) zygotes confirmed 16-18 hours post-insemination (<= Mature_Oocytes).
Analytical_Purpose: Measure fertilization efficiency across ICSI, conventional, and split insemination

Description: Laboratory gamete insemination technique used.
Analytical_Purpose: Evaluate laboratory fertilization rates and cost-value tradeoffs

Description: Total viable cleavage or blastocyst embryos developed from fertilized oocytes (<= Fertilized_Oocytes).
Analytical_Purpose: Quantify embryology laboratory attrition and cohort availability

Description: Count of embryos transferred into the uterus in the cycle (0 to 3; <= Number_of_Embryos).
Analytical_Purpose: Compare elective single embryo transfer (eSET) versus multi-embryo transfer outcomes

Description: Embryo transfer timing/modality or non-transfer disposition.
Expected_Values: Fresh Transfer, Frozen-Thawed Transfer, No Transfer
Analytical_Purpose: Distinguish fresh vs frozen-thawed transfer success rates and define transfer denominators

Description: Unique synthetic identifier for each graded viable embryo (Primary Key).
Analytical_Purpose: Embryo-level morphological tracking and cohort quality aggregation

Description: Foreign key linking each embryo to its parent cycle in ivf_treatment_cycles.csv.
Analytical_Purpose: Aggregate cohort embryo counts and top-transferred embryo grade per cycle

Description: Developmental culture day at final morphological assessment.
Analytical_Purpose: Compare cleavage-stage (Day 3) versus blastocyst-stage (Day 5) morphology and implantation

Description: Developmental stage classification at grading.
Expected_Values: Cleavage (<6 Cell / Fragmented), Cleavage (6-8 Cell), Cleavage (8-Cell Symmetric), Compacting Morula, Early Blastocyst, Full Blastocyst, Expanded Blastocyst, Hatching Blastocyst, Hatched Blastocyst
Analytical_Purpose: Granular developmental milestone profiling

Description: Gardner blastocoel cavity expansion score (1-6) for Day 5 blastocysts; Not Applicable on Day 3.
Analytical_Purpose: Assess blastocyst expansion progression and association with implantation

Description: Gardner Inner Cell Mass (ICM) cellularity/compaction grade for Day 5 blastocysts.
Analytical_Purpose: Evaluate fetal-lineage cell mass morphology vs clinical pregnancy

Description: Gardner Trophectoderm (TE) cohesive epithelium grade for Day 5 blastocysts.
Analytical_Purpose: Evaluate placental-lineage morphology as predictor of uterine implantation

Description: Standardized composite embryo quality tier across Day 3 and Day 5 systems.
Analytical_Purpose: Primary categorical predictor for embryo quality vs implantation and live birth analysis

Description: Composite alphanumeric embryology notation (e.g., 4AA, 3BB for Day 5; D3-8G1 for Day 3).
Analytical_Purpose: Detailed embryology benchmark reporting

Description: Unique synthetic identifier for each cycle outcome record (Primary Key).
Analytical_Purpose: Unique outcome tracking per IVF cycle

Description: Foreign key referencing ivf_treatment_cycles.csv (1:1 in cleaned data).
Analytical_Purpose: Join biological and clinical endpoints to cycle, patient, embryo, and cost tables

Description: Ultrasound-confirmed intrauterine embryonic implantation status.
Analytical_Purpose: Compute cycle-level implantation proportion per transfer and per initiated cycle

Description: Serum beta-hCG biochemical pregnancy test outcome 10-14 days post-transfer.
Analytical_Purpose: Measure biochemical conception and quantify early biochemical loss prior to ultrasound sac

Description: Confirmation of intrauterine gestational sac with fetal heartbeat at 6-7 weeks.
Analytical_Purpose: Compute clinical pregnancy rate across age groups, protocols, and embryo grades

Description: Delivery of at least one live-born infant resulting from the cycle.
Analytical_Purpose: Ultimate clinical effectiveness KPI and denominator for cost-per-live-birth

Description: Administrative tracking status of post-transfer clinical follow-up.
Expected_Values: Completed, Ongoing Follow-Up, Lost to Follow-Up
Analytical_Purpose: Monitor outcome completeness and evaluate sensitivity to incomplete follow-up

Description: Unique synthetic identifier for each cycle billing record (Primary Key).
Analytical_Purpose: Financial record tracking

Description: Foreign key referencing ivf_treatment_cycles.csv (1:1 in cleaned data).
Analytical_Purpose: Connect itemized financial expenditure to clinical protocols and outcomes

Description: Physician evaluation, counseling, and ultrasound monitoring consultation fees.
Analytical_Purpose: Assess baseline clinical service cost share

Description: Gonadotropins, GnRH analogs, trigger, and luteal support pharmaceutical charges.
Analytical_Purpose: Analyze stimulation protocol cost drivers and ovarian reserve dose sensitivity

Description: Embryology culture, ICSI micromanipulation, and PGT-A laboratory fees.
Analytical_Purpose: Evaluate laboratory add-on cost impact relative to clinical gain

Description: Operating room, anesthesia, oocyte retrieval, and embryo transfer procedure charges.
Analytical_Purpose: Quantify surgical/procedural cost component across fresh, frozen, and cancelled transfers

Description: Ancillary charges including embryo vitrification, storage, and biopsy handling.
Analytical_Purpose: Track optional ancillary utilization and total billing reconciliation

Description: Exact sum of Consultation, Medication, Laboratory, Procedure, and Additional costs.
Analytical_Purpose: Overall financial distribution, cost-effectiveness, and resource optimization analysis
